expires.description: Expires is when this resource expires (RFC3339).

labels.description: Labels are arbitrary key/value pairs attached to the resource.

namespace.description: Namespace is the resource namespace (usually left blank).

revision.description: Revision is used for optimistic concurrency control.

spec.description: LoginRule resource definition v1 from Teleport

priority.description: Priority is the priority of the login rule relative to other login rules in the same cluster. Login rules with a lower numbered priority will be evaluated first.

traits_expression.description: TraitsExpression is a predicate expression which should return the desired traits for the user upon login.

traits_map.description: TraitsMap is a map of trait keys to lists of predicate expressions which should evaluate to the desired values for that trait.
